paras: Unleash the full potential of your Honda FL5 Civic Type R with the expertly designed Front Lip. Engineered for both performance and aesthetics, this front lip enhances aerodynamics by increasing downforce, improving high-speed stability, and reducing front-end lift. Crafted from high-quality, lightweight carbon fibre, this front lip is the perfect upgrade for enthusiasts looking to maximize their vehicle's aggressive stance and handling precision.

Designed specifically for the Honda Civic Type R, the front lip seamlessly integrates with the car's existing body lines, delivering a bold, race-inspired look without compromising functionality. Whether you're on the track or the street, this front lip ensures your Type R looks as fast as it drives.
